title: Architectural Visualization Refinement
business: A boutique architectural firm specializing in historical building renovations.
problem: The firm struggles to integrate modern structural additions into existing historical site photographs, often resulting in mismatched lighting, perspective errors, or loss of architectural detail during manual editing.
solution: The firm utilizes GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst to perform precise inpainting, allowing them to mask specific areas of historical site photos and generate photorealistic structural additions that inherit the lighting and texture of the original environment.
steps: Upload the original high-resolution historical site photograph to the Image API.
Define the target region for the new structure using an alpha-channel mask.
Submit the masked image and a descriptive prompt to the gpt-image-2.5-sunburst model.
Select the 'xhigh' quality setting to ensure fine architectural details are preserved.
Review the generated output and iterate using the same model if structural adjustments are needed.
outcome: The firm achieves seamless visual integration of new designs into legacy environments, significantly reducing the time spent on manual post-production blending.
limitation: The model may struggle with extreme perspective shifts if the input image lacks sufficient depth information; verify this by checking the alignment of generated structural lines against the original vanishing points.
